description: Chief Ministry of Western Province - By-Law relating to Food Production and Distribution Centers of Wattala- Mabola Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the approval and publication of new by-laws (specifically relating to food production and distribution centers) under the Urban Councils Ordinance. It establishes regulatory requirements, licensing conditions, and compliance standards for businesses in this sector, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a government official (Chief Minister) in the approval notice, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing the regulatory framework, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or structural government changes that would trigger a government classification type.
